crossRefs.note: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land…
Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones…
Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit…
They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of…
and they were brought back to Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
translations.bsb: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.
translations.kjv: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
translations.asv: By faith Joseph, when his end was nigh, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
